set.body:
Source: upper-layer Site/pilot design review supplied by the user on 2026-07-23.

Problem:
JobObservation exposes state/reason/raw fields but no typed start, projected end, or time-limit facts. A lease layer would have to parse string escape hatches, and adding these fields after publication would break the agent protocol.

Scope and acceptance:
- Add a truthful timing model that distinguishes actual from expected start and limited, unlimited, partition-derived, and unknown time limits.
- Surface Slurm's reported/projected end time; do not force consumers to assume startedAt + timeLimit is authoritative.
- Parse v0.0.43 start_time, end_time, and time_limit no-value representations with explicit bounds and sentinel handling.
- Parse StartTime, EndTime, and TimeLimit from focused scontrol evidence without failing on unrelated spaced values.
- Give JobObservation an explicitly owned backward-aware wire representation with golden fixtures and round-trip/malformed tests.
- Keep lease/deadline policy above scala-slurm.
set.title: P6f.21: Surface typed scheduler timing facts
